title: A node can carry a letter tag such as (a)
body:
Today panels number themselves in source order, and `marker` and `text` take a `number`. Nothing letters the parts inside a panel. The sufr pipeline figure in `sufr-figures` puts "(a)" to "(d)" beside each graphic in a stage, so a part can be cited as 1(b). Each letter is a `text` node placed by a script from the graphic's left edge and height.

## Proposal

Any drawn node takes `tag "TEXT"`. acre sets the text in a small bold face, a fixed gap left of the node's box and centred on it vertically. `tag auto` gives the next letter in source order within the enclosing panel, starting at "(a)".

```text
row strips { tag auto; at 200 160; unit 24 24; chars "$%ACGNT"; }
```

## Open

- A `tag-side left | top-left` property for a node with no room on its left.
- Whether `tag auto` restarts in each panel or runs on through the canvas.
